declared_CPU_comparison_tolerance.scope: Numerical frame-composition agreement only; not physical/collision/real precision

formula: T_parent_child(q) = T_parent_joint0 * R_or_Prismatic_axis(q) * inverse(T_child_joint1); compose USD graph, compare inverse(T_TCP)*T_link to URDF graph with fixed hand-to-TCP
limitations: Agreement is checked at3 actual closed public proprioceptive samples; not a theorem for all joint configurations.
Float-authored joint frames differ slightly from URDF decimal frames; maximum errors are reported without interpreting them as solver or real-world precision.
This verifies attachment of static USD body-local input boxes to URDF frame names at sampled joint states. It does not verify cooked shape extents, padding or obstacle clearances.
No public observation image, target, object, instrument, world TCP pose, contact or episode time is copied into this robot-only derivative.
